transit.header: PATHAlert - Hoboken & Exchange Place station elevator outages
transit.description: The Hoboken elevator and Exchange Place station elevators 55 & 66 will be shut down to protect against coastal flooding from anticipated rain. HBLR will cross-honor PATH riders in need of elevator/ ADA access at HOB, EXPL, and NWPT station from 9am 11/26 - 8am 11/27.
